[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Shared zorg record parser, multi-block mirroring, and book [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]reading state[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]record-model[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]record-model: turn coverage.rs's counter into a shared zorg record [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]parser (owner block, ID/LID, block range, fields). Make mirroring [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]id-aware and let one note mirror several blocks (`source_blocks`). [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob ref migrate-zorg dry-run planner and report[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]planner[dim] · [dim][/dim]after record-model[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]planner: add `bob ref migrate-zorg` (dry run by default). It plans one [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]legacy note per record, with books folding their chapters. It picks [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]collision-free stems, ref_type, title, URLs, and tags, renders the notes[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]exactly, and prints a human or JSON report: counts by file and status, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]renamed targets, records without a URL, identity hits, already migrated,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and skipped. Add CLI tests, help and completion updates, and docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Reversible --write path, rollback runbook, and scope caveat[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]writer[dim] · [dim][/dim]after planner[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]writer: add `-w/--write`. Under bob_sync.lock it pre-syncs, re-plans, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and refuses existing targets. It then writes new files only, verifies [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]them through the index and coverage, and deletes its own files on any [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]failure. Then one scoped commit and a post-sync. Test it against temp [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]git vaults, document the rollback, and update the coverage.scope caveat.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Run the migration on athena and verify coverage[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]live-run[dim] · [dim][/dim]after writer[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]live-run: build the landed master on athena and dry-run against ~/bob. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Check every number against the expected table and stop for Bryan on any [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]deviation. Run --write, verify doctor, find, list, and show plus an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]idempotent rerun, install the build, and record the evidence and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rollback sha on the bead.[/#D7D7AF]
